bug: HMcode2020._mead_terms() returned (1.0, 1.0) - the Einstein-de Sitter value - whenever no growth-terms provider was passed, instead of failing. Both Mead (2017) fits (dc_Mead, Dv_Mead) are written in terms of x and y, so the entire halo model silently ran in the EdS limit.
why_it_was_never_caught: rg finds no importer of HMcode2020 anywhere outside hmcode.py, and power.py has no nonlinear entry point, so the class had never been executed against CAMB at all. The fallback made it produce plausible-looking numbers in the wrong cosmology.
real_term_values: for this LCDM cosmology at z = 0 the terms are x = 0.78757, y = 0.93141, gnorm = 0.78757
fix: _mead_terms now raises ValueError when terms is None, naming the required argument. Verified: constructing without terms raises, constructing with terms=lambda z: sigma.growth_terms(bg, z) gives 1.09%.
